latest_release.name: SolidCraft v0.40.1
latest_release.body:
**0.40.1 is a fix release for 0.40.0. Designs saved in 0.40.1 open in 0.40.0 with a warning about the newer format; 0.30.1 refuses them.**

SolidCraft is open-source parametric 3D CAD in Rust: sketch, constrain, extrude, and change a parameter to watch the timeline rebuild. [Website](https://solidcraft.io) · [documentation](https://docs.solidcraft.io/) · [Discord](https://solidcraft.io/discord) · [issues](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/issues).

## Fixed
- **Copy and paste work again on the desktop.** Since 0.40.0, copying did nothing in the desktop app: Copy Error Message, Copy diagnostic information, Ctrl+C in a text field, and paste. The clipboard is back, and a test now fails if the desktop build loses it again (#15144).
- **A cut through a body's edge builds again** when its sketch sits a few micrometres off that edge. It used to fail with "SMLib's check refuses the result: SmFace::Test #36 Face Near missing Seam" (#14849).
- **Lofts through parallel sections no longer dip behind their first section,** so a carved top joins onto the slab it starts from again, as it did in 0.30.1. Lofts that already built correctly are unchanged (#15176).

## Also in this release
- A shell of a cone that comes to a point builds instead of failing with status 1001 (#14981).
- Loft rails take sections whose curves are of different kinds (#13909).
- Show Dimensions draws a sketch dimension again when the sketch is seen nearly edge-on (#15197).
- A box placed by its centre stays centred when you change its size (#14603).
- Export Current View as DXF writes round holes and arcs as circles and arcs, not many short lines (#14935).
- Trimming by a projected curve stops with an error when it can't tell a face's side of the curve, instead of keeping the wrong face (#14701).
- Sweeping along a path with many corners is about twice as fast (#15097).
- The window no longer freezes when you edit the design while an agent's batch is being shown (#15155).
- The operations panel says how each operation ended, and an agent's Stop stops it (#9501).
- The 3D printing tint shows only while Send to Slicer is open and is no longer saved in the design (#11559).
- STEP import keeps a face's curves inside its bounds when its surface ends on a quarter line (#15029).

## Snap
The `.snap` packages for x86_64 and aarch64 are attached below. This build is also uploaded to the Snap Store's candidate channel.

## Compatibility
0.40.1 writes design file format 54 (0.40.0 wrote 53). Format 54 records a box placed by its centre. 0.40.1 reads every earlier format. Designs saved in 0.40.1 open in 0.40.0 (and rc.3 and rc.4) with a warning about the newer format, and saving there keeps what that version can't read. One thing looks different there: a box placed by its centre is drawn with that centre as its corner, so it sits shifted until the design is opened in 0.40.1 again. 0.30.1 and earlier refuse a design saved by 0.40.1.

## Downloads
`.exe`, `.msi` and portable `.zip` for Windows; `.dmg` for macOS; `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.flatpak`, `.snap`, `.tar.gz` and Arch packages for Linux; a `.tar.gz` for FreeBSD; and `solidcraft-web-0.40.1.zip`, a static site to host yourself. Check them with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt --ignore-missing`.

The macOS app is signed with a Developer ID and notarized. The Windows files are signed with a self-signed test certificate that Windows doesn't trust, so Windows may warn you. The other packages are unsigned.

The full notes for 0.40, including its new kernel, mesher and STEP reader, are in the [0.40.0 release](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/releases/tag/v0.40.0).

detail.readme:
SolidCraft

An open-source parametric 3D CAD application built in pure Rust.
Sketch, constrain, and build solids with a parametric feature timeline. Change a dimension and watch your model rebuild. Run it on your desktop, in your browser, or let AI agents model through the built-in MCP server.

[![Download for Windows][badge-windows]][windows-msi] [![Download for macOS][badge-macos]][macos-dmg] [![Download for Linux][badge-linux]][linux-appimage] [![Get it from the Snap Store][badge-snap]][snap-store] [![Try it in your browser][badge-web]][web-app]

Website · Download · Try it in the browser · Documentation · Discord · SolidCore

![SolidCraft: model a Raspberry Pi 4 case from an empty design: a sketch dimensioned with parameters, extrude, fillets and shell, a rim rounded in one pick, standoffs patterned on the board's mounting holes, port cut-outs, vent slots, "Pi 4" engraved in a font, a PETG material with its mass in Properties, and a height change in Parameters](docs/screenshots/demo.gif) *A Raspberry Pi 4 case from an empty design: a sketch dimensioned with the board's parameters, extrude, fillet, shell, the rim rounded in one pick, an M2.5 standoff patterned on the 58 × 49 mm hole rectangle, port cut-outs, vent slots, "Pi 4" engraved in DejaVu Sans Bold and a PETG material defined in the design, with its mass in Properties, then height 24 → 32 mm in Parameters and it all rebuilds. 6× playback with the idle pauses cut. [Full video](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/raw/refs/heads/main/docs/screenshots/demo.mp4), recorded with the [demo script](examples/demo/record_ui.sh).* ## Download - **Windows:** the [installer][windows-msi]. - **macOS:** the [disk image][macos-dmg] (Apple silicon and Intel). - **Linux:** the [AppImage][linux-appimage], or `sudo snap install solidcraft` ([Snap Store][snap-store]). - **Web:** [try it in your browser][web-app], no install. ARM64 and 32-bit builds, portable zip, .deb, .rpm, Flatpak and the other packages are on the [downloads page](docs/downloads.md). The macOS app is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. The Windows downloads aren't signed yet: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway** in SmartScreen. On SolidCraft 0.11 to 0.14, download once by hand; see [updating](https://docs.solidcraft.io/guide/updates.html#updating-from-011-to-014). ## What works Early but usable for simple parts: 75 of 76 public reference parts match their analytic or FreeCAD-computed volume, area, centre of mass and bounding box ([oracle](docs/oracle.md)); the other is a tracked bug. - **Sketches and constraints:** lines, arcs, splines, text and more, solved by our own constraint solver, with parameter-driven dimensions. - **Features:** extrude, revolve, sweep, loft, fillet, chamfer, shell, draft, holes, threads, patterns, mirror, split and combine on an editable parametric timeline. - **Parameters and configurations** with unit-aware expressions. - **Assemblies** with joints, motion studies, contact sets, interference and mass properties. - **Sheet metal** with flanges, hems, fold/unfold and flat patterns, and plastic enclosure features. - **Files:** STEP, IGES, 3MF, STL, OBJ and glTF in and out where supported, URDF export, `.sc` designs (`.solidcraft` files from earlier releases still open). - **Desktop app, browser app, headless CLI and MCP server**, all running the same commands. The full list is in [docs/capabilities.md](docs/capabilities.md) and [docs/features.md](docs/features.md); status and plans are in [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md). See also [what people built](docs/showcase.md), [3D mouse support](docs/3d-mouse.md) and the [architecture](docs/architecture.md). ## Build from source ```sh cargo run --release -p solidcraft -- --sample # desktop app with a sample part cargo run --release -p solidcraft-cli -- commands # the command registry cargo run --release -p solidcraft-cli -- run examples/bracket.json --out bracket.step cargo xtask ci # fmt, clippy, tests, icons, assets, layers, wasm ``` More commands, the Windows cross-build and the browser build are in [docs/building.md](docs/building.md). ## AI agents (MCP) `solidcraft-cli mcp` is a [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server. Headless it runs its own design session, or with `--connect` it drives the running app so you can watch. Claude Code: `claude mcp add solidcraft -- solidcraft-cli mcp`. If a terminal doesn't find `solidcraft-cli` (older Windows installers don't put it on `PATH`), give its full path (by default `"C:\\Program Files\\SolidCraft\\solidcraft-cli.exe"`). Tools, access rules and an example session: [docs/mcp.md](docs/mcp.md). ## Scripts A script is a JSON list of the same commands the UI runs, executed with `solidcraft-cli run`. Format and example: [docs/scripts.md](docs/scripts.md). Pages can also be driven through the [browser command API](docs/browser-api.md). ## Contributing Help is welcome. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) covers how to build and test, the code map, the clean-room and licence rules, and where help is wanted most. Open work is in [GitHub issues](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/issues); chat is on [Discord](https://discord.gg/FtU4NQNVDH). ## Sponsors [![CI powered by Blacksmith](docs/sponsors/blacksmith-ci-powered.png)](https://www.blacksmith.sh) SolidCraft's continuous integration runs on [Blacksmith](https://www.blacksmith.sh), which sponsors its CI minutes. ## Disclaimer The files in this repository are provided as is, without warranty, liability or indemnity, and Tangency Labs and the contributors accept no responsibility for any harmful or unlawful use of them: read [DISCLAIMER.md](DISCLAIMER.md). ## Licence MIT OR Apache-2.0, at your option. Developed under the [clean-room contribution rules](AGENTS.md); third-party code and assets retain their documented licences and attribution. SolidCraft's brand and interface are licensed separately, under [LICENSE-BRAND](LICENSE-BRAND): the UI kit, the look (interface icons, glyphs, built-in themes), the theme's design tokens and palettes, and the SolidCraft name, logo and app icon. Use them freely as part of SolidCraft. Using them in another program or product needs the maintainers' written permission first. SolidCraft is independent. Behaviour is designed from public documentation, general CAD conventions and user feedback. Reference tests use analytic values and open-source tools. SolidCraft is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Autodesk, Dassault Systèmes, PTC, Siemens or any other CAD vendor.
